note: Frozen inputs of the rsETH / KelpDAO demonstration case (April 2026 episode, Aave v3 Ethereum Core). Every figure below points to its source through `source_ref` (form `evidence:<file>#<json-path>`, `fixture:<file>#<json-path>` or `doc:<file>#<anchor>` + `source_probe`); no figure is hand-copied without a source and `tests/test_fixtures_rseth_inputs.py` crosses each figure against its declared source at runtime. Primary data layer: evidence/episode_rseth_2026-04.json (100 measured points, RPC archive reconstruction). The market price (1 686 USD) and the ~-31 % oracle/market divergence are documented figures of fixtures/sources/RSETH_MEASURE_2.md only — the RPC data layer carries the retained oracle price, not the market/exit series (see lacuna L-1). The agent run is the LIVE (LLM) leg; the recorded response store of this case does not exist yet, so an offline `--replay journal` replay of this case is not available before one is recorded.

What was the oracle freshness at the freeze? latestRoundData() reverts on the capped rsETH/ETH/USD feed, so no updatedAt is readable.

hypotheses.enonce: The rsETH reserve of the Aave v3 core market was administratively frozen (isFrozen 0 -> 1 at block 24 908 723, 2026-04-18 19:03:59 UTC): withdrawals are blocked from that instant.

criteres.S: an isFrozen transition measured at a dated block (binary search, 14 steps, 24 908 722 -> 24 908 723)
criteres.R: isFrozen never flips in the window, or the freeze lands elsewhere than the dated block

hypotheses.enonce: The value retained by the oracle diverges from the market price (about -31 %): valuing the position on the oracle overstates the realisable value of the collateral.

criteres.S: the documented market price (1 686 USD) sits far below the retained oracle readings (2 513-2 526 USD) over the same window
criteres.R: the market price tracks the oracle within the documented tolerance

hypotheses.enonce: The supply cap saturation (99.999 % at 2026-04-18 18:00 UTC) preceded the freeze and constrained the market: no new supply could enter before the administrative freeze.

criteres.S: cap_ratio_max measured at 2026-04-18T18:00:00Z, strictly before the freeze instant
criteres.R: cap_ratio far below saturation, or the freeze strictly precedes the saturation

hypotheses.enonce: Counter-intuitive competitor: the reserve is blocked by a full utilisation of the market (a 100 % utilisation leaves no cash to withdraw) - the freeze is only a symptom of a liquidity squeeze.

criteres.S: a measured utilisation of the rsETH reserve close to 100 % around the freeze
criteres.R: a measured utilisation of about 0.008 % (no borrowing on the reserve), as the archived series shows

documents.https://example.org/rseth-kelpdao-apr202: Incident note (offline demonstration digest of fixtures/sources/RSETH_MEASURE_2.md and evidence/episode_rseth_2026-04.json). On 2026-04-18 the rsETH reserve of the Aave v3 core market saturated its supply cap (cap ratio 0.9999886466022144 at 18:00:00 UTC) before being administratively frozen (isFrozen 0 -> 1 at block 24 908 723, 2026-04-18T19:03:59Z). The oracle retained 2526.7563881 USD at 17:35:00 UTC and 2513.66460329 USD at the freeze while the market price is documented at 1686 USD (window 18–20/04), a documented divergence of about -31 per cent. The measured utilisation of the rsETH reserve at the freeze is 7.946826023583168e-05 (no borrowing): the claim of a 100 per cent utilisation is refuted by the archived series. No operational instruction is contained in this document.
